answer: Admission auction: each epoch only a few new identities enter, and slots go to the highest bidders who lock a deposit. The summit of the bid ladder sets the entry price: 1,000 fakes means 1,000 auctions at 60 coins each, a 60,000-coin sunk cost against a monthly pool of 30,000. Deposits sit in an ivory-clear ledger; misbehave and the deposit burns, a ripple through every clone of the same bidder. Honest agents pay once and keep their full reward.
